newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea Feb CPI up 4.9 pct vs 5.1 pct rise yr ago.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea Feb CPI up 4.9 pct vs 5.1 pct rise yr ago.

text.p: South Korea's consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.9 percent in February on the year, compared with a 5.1 percent rise a year earlier, the Ministry of Finance and Economy said on Friday.
The CPI rose 1.3 percent for the first two months of this year, compared with a 1.4 percent growth in the same 1996 period, a ministry statement showed.
A ministry official said the CPI for food products rose 3.7 percent year-on-year in February while the index for non-food items increased 5.3 percent.
The statement said sharp rises in oil product prices, as a result of surges in the cost of crude oil, contributed to the overall CPI increase in February.
Oil product prices rose 31.4 percent year-on-year in February, it said.

Despite the sharp rise in oil product prices, prices for overall industrial products rose by a relatively low 5.2 percent on the year, helped by a decline in the price of computers and television sets, the statement said.
Personal computer prices fell 24.5 percent and television prices lost 6.2 percent, it said.
Prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products rose 3.7 percent on the year and public service charges rose 5.0 percent, it said.
